names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Михаил (Березин), иерей, сщмч.»: the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Михаила пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера (1937).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS. The line says «пресвитера» and the name page «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are the source’s own words; `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. A Cyrillic grep for «Березин» over every `saint.json` returns `paul-berezin` alone, another forename and another day, and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page prints one hymn only, a kontakion of the venerable Melania, and nothing under this name.
